"use client";

import { DataList, Stack } from "@chakra-ui/react"

export const DataListWithSizes = () => {
  return (
    <Stack gap="4">
      <DataList.Root size="sm">
        <DataList.Item>
          <DataList.ItemLabel>Name</DataList.ItemLabel>
          <DataList.ItemValue>John Doe</DataList.ItemValue>
        </DataList.Item>
      </DataList.Root>
      <DataList.Root size="md">
        <DataList.Item>
          <DataList.ItemLabel>Name</DataList.ItemLabel>
          <DataList.ItemValue>John Doe</DataList.ItemValue>
        </DataList.Item>
      </DataList.Root>
      <DataList.Root size="lg">
        <DataList.Item>
          <DataList.ItemLabel>Name</DataList.ItemLabel>
          <DataList.ItemValue>John Doe</DataList.ItemValue>
        </DataList.Item>
      </DataList.Root>
    </Stack>
  )
}

# Chakra UI data list

7 published Chakra UI data list examples with complete pinned source and MIT attribution.

## Installation

- Complete MIT examples with a ChakraProvider using defaultSystem.
- Reuse the application-level ChakraProvider when integrating; keep HiddenInput in checkbox and switch compositions for keyboard and form semantics.

- Copy every returned file and preserve the MIT licence notice.
- Render the returned preview.tsx example, or integrate the example into your existing provider.
